projects.title: Theme Exploration in Public Research Abstracts

bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised capstone, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration using scikit-learn, examined topic stability across repeated fits, and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
